CustomField.description:
Activity Metrics - The date when the last task was completed
If for example, a task is completed before the due date, the Last Task Date is different from the Due Date. Because tasks show up on the activity timeline according to their due date, inconsistencies could exist between the Last Task Date and what’s on the activity timeline.
